notes.title: v0.6.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]

[u][b]A Whole New World: "Aicun"[/b][/u]
Step into a dazzling and vibrant new realm—Aicun! Known for its breathtakingly bright colors, this world introduces an entirely unique way of combat (but we’ll keep that a secret for now 😉).

[u][b]Memorybook[/b][/u]
We’ve added a special Memory Book to the bookshelf, designed to help you catch up on all the critical cutscenes you may have missed. Now, you don’t have to replay your entire journey just to experience them again!

[u][b]Spells, Items, and more[/b][/u]
A whole arsenal of new spells, items, armor, and weapons are now available, ready to enhance your adventures and bring fresh excitement to your battles.

[u][b]Guardian[/b][/u]
Meet Gladys, a charming and heartwarming new character! With her unwavering desire to help her friends, Gladys is a beacon of kindness. Plus, she has the special ability to wield color spells, even in worlds beyond Aicun.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[u][b]Fight Balancing[/b][/u]
We've made several adjustments to the difficulty of battles against normal monsters, ensuring a more balanced and enjoyable experience.
Bug Fixes:

[u][b]Trophy Notes[/b][/u]
For a better overview, the trophies that have not yet been implemented have been removed from the quest book.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[u][b]Teleportation Fixes[/b][/u]
Some teleportation and transfer issues have been resolved, ensuring smoother transitions throughout the game world.



We thank you for your patience and your help in improving Traveler. We love you and hope the best for the new year! ːluvː

notes.title: v0.5.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Embark on an electrifying adventure in the newly unveiled world of Saelis, where the very air crackles with the essence of electricity

[list]
[*] Illuminate the depths of Cendril's Caves with an extended lamp duration, ensuring that no shadow can obscure the beauty and danger within

🎁✨ We're thrilled to have you as part of our Traveler family – your excitement fuels our creative fires! And here's a festive joke for you: Why did the game developer go broke during the holiday season? Because they used up all their "Release Navidad" budget! 😄 Wishing you a joyous holiday season and countless adventures in the game ahead! 🌈🎄

notes.title: v0.5.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]

[list]
[*] The excessive list of learnable skills in the dialogs when the conditions are met were shrunken down to a notification that skills can be learned. This improves the user experience by reducing clutter and making it easier to understand skill acquisition.
[*] Midbosses became stronger, providing a greater challenge for players and enhancing the game's difficulty progression.
[*] VM: Terminal now has an Exit option, allowing players to easily exit the terminal interface without having to resort to alternative methods.
[*] You can now die from being poisoned or burned, adding a new layer of strategy and risk management to gameplay. Players will need to carefully manage their health and status effects to avoid fatal consequences.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Some minor bugs were fixed, including issues with Ultima and Cendril.
[*] The caves in Cendril now have correct backgrounds, and the monsters approaching the main character function as intended, improving the overall visual and gameplay experience.
[*] The minimap in Cendril's caves is now working properly, providing players with accurate navigation and orientation within the caves.
[*] Passibility errors in Cendril were fixed to ensure that players can move through the environment without getting stuck or encountering impassable obstacles.
[*] Two game-breaking bugs were addressed: the quest-givers in Cendril no longer cause crashes or game freezes, allowing players to progress smoothly through the game.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented skill trees for the main character and each guardian, allowing the use of scrolls once in battles.
[*] Introduced a new main option in the VM/Computer and the newly added world, Cendril.
[*] Guardians now provide information on their preferred and disliked team members when spoken to in their houses.
[*] Added an entirely new world: Cendril, a mesmerizing crystalline realm.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed the "German" language option due to numerous bugs.
[*] Enhanced the music settings to allow volume adjustment from 20% down to 5%.
[*] Altered attack and skill formulas to improve gameplay balance.
[*] Adjusted the parameters of The Seed to reduce its effectiveness.
[*] Implemented restrictions on teleport powder usage.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the calculation of Felliah's sweets, accurately tracking your sweet barometer. This feature now functions exclusively in Felliah.
[*] Prevented the deletion of the VM-World until the next book is discovered, resolving a previous issue.
[*] Resolved a bug where the Repair-Spell would malfunction when used on a robot.
[*] Rectified issues with VM - Gamelounge, ensuring its proper functionality.
[/list]


Wish you a lot of fun in investigating :-) And thanks for being with me ːluvː
